demoKind: local run of the evaluate / kernelcad dfm path on a development machine (not the hosted service, no moulded part)

settings.dfmSpec: process 'moulding', pullDirection '+z', minDraftDeg 1, minWallMm 1.2, maxWallMm 3.5, minRadiusMm 0.5
settings.render: software rasterizer over the kernel per-face tessellation, colours from the report's face refs; sharp; ffmpeg libx264 960x540, 24 fps, 3 x 4 s

proof.job: draft / undercut / wall / inside-corner review of an injection-moulded 80 x 50 x 25 mm enclosure base with a 2 mm wall

evidence.framesInspected: frames at 1 s, 2 s, 5 s, 6 s, 10 s and 11 s extracted from demo.mp4 and inspected visually

limits: Local validation only. Geometry checks against declared limits. No parting line is constructed, nothing was moulded, and no flow or warp simulation was run.
